findings.observation: The medium-skinned adult woman retains Calen’s angular diamond face, full cheeks, sharply defined brows, broad low nose bridge, full closed lips, and freckles.
The chibi narrows Calen’s torso and limbs toward an ordinary/slight build; the summon’s soft-rounded evident middle and gentle limb mass are not preserved strongly enough.
Both upper arms, forearms, wrists, and hands are coherent, naturally connected, and not generically inflated.
The black shaved-close-cropped hair retains the source front and side silhouette without an added accent.
The plum-gray fitted vest system, soft shirt, offset closures, high-waist trousers, narrow reinforced cuffs, flexible boots, and polished footwear remain legible with no added accessory or tattoo.
The complete hair-to-chin unit is visually about 31% of standing height, below the required 32–36% range and the intended 34–35% target.
Exactly one full-body adult has the complete head, both empty hands, and both feet visible inside generous safe margins.
The grounded three-quarter ready-idle stance, planted feet, compact silhouette, and readable empty hands work at combat-icon scale without a weapon.
No weapon, armor upgrade, magic, aura, glow, affinity cue, gem, floating, frame, star, number, UI, text, logo, watermark, extra person, or supernatural effect is present.
